# Inspecto Telco — demo script

<!-- generated by tools/render-product-docs.mjs from products/telco.toon and the hubs it links; never edit it: change the definition or those hubs, then run the tool -->

*Audience: presales and whoever runs a live demo. Product Map Item [`product.telco`](index.md) · a Domain product for the Telecom Industry.*

## Before you start

Run the **demo** Distribution: it signs people in as Demo Users with no password, on 127.0.0.1 only, over synthetic data. Never give it to a customer or use it with real data. The Space `telco` is pre-installed with its seeded state; the presenter text `products/telco.demo-build.txt` ships in the bundle.

1. Run `bin\serve-demo.bat` (Windows) or `bin/serve-demo.sh` (Linux), then open http://127.0.0.1:8080.
2. Pick a Demo User on the sign-in page (below).
3. Move between the Apps with the App switcher at the top of the rail.

## Demo Users

| Sign in as | Name | What they show |
|---|---|---|
| `admin` | Demo Admin | Platform administrator: every area and setting |
| `ra.analyst` | Demo RA Analyst | Revenue Assurance analyst: runs Jobs, works Incidents and Cases |
| `fm.analyst` | Demo FM Analyst | Fraud analyst: runs Jobs, works Incidents and Cases |
| `fm.manager` | Demo FM Manager | Fraud manager: also authors Alert Rules and Pipelines |
| `viewer` | Demo Viewer | Non-privileged viewer: reads, changes nothing |

## The walk-through

Open on the sign-in page: **Find the leakage, catch the fraud, close the case.**

### 1. [Revenue Assurance](../../app/telco-ra/index.md)

- **Reconciliations** — Compare switch, mediation, rating and billing, and see every break they leave.
- **KPIs** — Follow completeness, leakage found and leakage recovered over time.
- Its Alert Rules:`ra_data_quality`, `ra_leakage_found`.

### 2. [Case Management](../../app/case-management/index.md)

- **Alerts** — Every Alert the Apps raise, newest first, with the Incident it opened.
- **Incidents** — Triage, assign and resolve what the Alerts opened, with its impact.
- **Cases** — Group related Incidents into one Case and work it to a decision.

### 3. [Fraud Management](../../app/telco-fraud/index.md)

- **Risk scores** — See which lines score highest for SIM-box and bypass, and which factors raised them.
- **Anomaly models** — Find lines whose usage moves away from their own history.
- Its Alert Rules:`fraud_adjustment`, `fraud_data_bypass`, `fraud_dealer`, `fraud_identity`, `fraud_internal`, `fraud_irsf`, `fraud_premium_rate`, `fraud_recharge`, `fraud_reversal`, `fraud_roaming`, `fraud_sim_swap`, `fraud_simbox`, `fraud_voucher`, `fraud_wangiri`, `tb_allowed_line_changed`, `tb_box_suspected`, `tb_sim_high`.

### 4. [Link Analysis](../../app/link-analysis/index.md)

- **Link Analysis** — Investigate how entities link, one expand step at a time.
- **Data** — Your Datasets: add files, see what arrived, and choose how each is read as a graph.
- **Geo** — Place entities and routes on a map, over any Dataset with coordinates.
- **Entities** — See what the data says about each Entity Type and each Entity: how many, where, how fresh.
- **Entity Lists** — Keep watch lists of entities, with every change on the record.
- **Alerts** — See fired Alerts, and open the Investigation behind a standing detection.

## Close

Say the tagline: *Find revenue leakage and fraud in your network's records, see who is linked to whom, and work every case to a decision.*

Editions: [Standard](../../edition/standard/index.md) · [Advanced](../../edition/advanced/index.md). Distributions: production, trial, demo, pilot. The [datasheet](features.md) says which Apps each Edition can carry.

## Reset

Stop the server, delete .\spaces\telco, and restore that folder from the zip (re-extract spaces\telco). Anything done during a session (assignments, dispositions, new Alert Rules) lives in that folder, so a reset discards it.
